product.title: Highlights of Paris Bike Tour with a Local Guide

description.text: Spin through the city streets like a local and explore the French capital in style on this small-group (or private) bike tour of Paris. Follow your guide to top attractions such as Les Invalides, the Louvre, and the Eiffel Tower. Stops include Ecole Militaire, Hôtel des Invalides, Place de la Concorde, Louvre Museum, Pont Alexandre III, Seine River. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Paris landmarks, river views, and neighborhood walking or cycling highlights. Ideal for visitors basing in Paris who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Ecole Militaire, Hôtel des Invalides, Place de la Concorde, Louvre Museum that define this Paris sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
